faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about tracing, photos, Pinterest, and ads.

items.question: Is DrawingPilot free?
items.answer: Yes. DrawingPilot is free to download and use. It shows ads.

items.question: Do you upload my camera or my drawings?
items.answer: No. The camera is used as a live view for tracing. Photos, projects and line art stay on your device unless you save, share or export them yourself.

items.question: How does Pinterest work?
items.answer: You can connect a Pinterest account to import boards and pins. The connection uses an anonymous sign-in, and the Pinterest tokens are stored on our server so the app can fetch pins for you. We do not post to Pinterest.

items.question: Which languages does DrawingPilot support?
items.answer: English, Hebrew, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese (Simplified).

items.question: Can I turn off personalised ads?
items.answer: Yes. Open Settings → Ad privacy choices to review or change ad consent. On iPhone you can also decline tracking in the App Tracking Transparency prompt.

items.question: Where are my projects stored?
items.answer: On your device. You can put them in folders, rename them, duplicate them, share them or delete them. Uninstalling the app removes that copy.

items.question: Does line art use a server?
items.answer: No. The edges, pencil, blueprint and cartoon conversions run on the phone.

items.question: Can I record a tracing session?
items.answer: Yes. You can record the camera view and save the video to your photo library.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for DrawingPilot — AR drawing and tracing. Photos stay on your device. Pinterest tokens are stored on our server. Ads by Google AdMob with consent.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use DrawingPilot and the pages we publish for it.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the DrawingPilot app for iOS and Android and the legal pages we publish for it.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: DrawingPilot keeps your drawings on your device. A few features use a sign-in or a server.
items: Camera: the live camera is shown so you can trace an image onto paper, and you can record that session. We do not upload the camera preview. A recording is saved to your photo library only when you save it.
Photos and projects: images you import, line art, project names and folders stay on your device. Line art is created on the device. We do not receive those files.
Anonymous sign-in (Firebase Authentication): the app signs in anonymously so Cloud Functions can act for that install. This creates an anonymous identifier. It is not your name or email.

Pinterest: if you connect Pinterest, we store the OAuth tokens for that anonymous account on our server and use them to read your boards and pins (scopes boards:read, pins:read and user_accounts:read). We do not post, edit or delete pins. You can disconnect in the app.

Advertising: Google AdMob may process your device's advertising identifier, IP address and ad interactions to show and measure ads. On iOS, the advertising identifier is used only if you allow tracking. The app may also show ads for other Zuki Apps.
Crash reports and diagnostics (Firebase Crashlytics): device model, OS version, app version and the technical details of a crash. They do not include your photos, project names or Pinterest searches.
Usage analytics (Firebase Analytics), only after you give consent: screens opened and coarse feature events. Events never contain project names, image contents or Pinterest queries.

section3.title: 3. How we use information
items: Show the tracing camera and save what you choose to keep
Import boards and pins after you connect Pinterest
Show and measure ads (Google AdMob)
Find and fix crashes
Understand which features are used, if you consented
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section4.title: 4. Advertising and consent
section4.content: Where required, you are asked for consent before personalised ads are shown, using Google's consent form. On iOS, Apple's App Tracking Transparency prompt asks before the advertising identifier is used.
section4.content2: You can review or change ad consent in the app under Settings → Ad privacy choices, and limit ad tracking in your device settings.

section5.title: 5. Storage and security
section5.content: Photos, projects and line art stay on your device unless you save, share or export them yourself. Pinterest tokens are stored in Firebase and are readable only by our Cloud Functions, not by the app directly. Data sent by the SDKs is encrypted in transit.
section5.content2: Google retains advertising, crash, analytics and authentication data under its own policies. Pinterest processes the account connection under Pinterest's privacy policy.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Google AdMob and Firebase (Authentication, Cloud Functions, Crashlytics, Analytics) process data under Google's privacy policy. Pinterest processes the account connection under Pinterest's privacy policy.
section6.content2: Saving a recording uses your photo library. Sharing a project uses your device's share sheet; we do not see what you share or with whom.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your region you may have rights to access or delete data. Delete projects in the app, disconnect Pinterest in the app, or uninstall the app. Uninstalling removes the on-device copy. To delete the anonymous account and its server-side Pinterest tokens, email us from the address below. For data held by Google or Pinterest, see their privacy controls.
section7.content2: DrawingPilot is not directed at children under 13, and it is not part of a Designed for Families program.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.

terms.intro: Please read these Terms of Use carefully before using DrawingPilot. By accessing or using the app you agree to these Terms.

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: These Terms govern your access to and use of DrawingPilot ("Service", "App"), operated by Zuki Apps.
section1.content2: If you use the Service on behalf of a minor, you represent that you are the parent or guardian and accept these Terms on their behalf.

section2.title: 2. Description of Service
section2.content: DrawingPilot helps you trace a reference image onto paper. The Service includes:
items: A reference image over the live camera, with size, rotation, opacity and lock
Import from your gallery or camera, and on-device line art
Optional Pinterest import after you connect an account
Projects stored on your device, and an optional recording saved to your photo library
Ads served by Google AdMob

section3.title: 3. Your content and Pinterest
section3.content: You keep the rights to the photos and drawings you create. You are responsible for having the right to trace or import an image, including pins you import from Pinterest.
section3.content2: Pinterest content is provided by Pinterest under your account and Pinterest's own terms. We do not claim ownership of pins. Connecting Pinterest lets the app read boards and pins; it does not let us post on your behalf.

section4.title: 4. Licence and subscriptions
section4.content: Zuki Apps grants you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the app on devices you own or control. The app is free and shows ads.
section4.content2: We may later offer an optional auto-renewing subscription, billed by Apple or Google, for extra features and to remove ads. If we do, the price and period are shown by the store before you buy, and you can cancel in that store's subscription settings. Projects stay on your device; we cannot restore them if you uninstall or change devices.

section5.title: 5. Acceptable use
items: Use the app for unlawful purposes or to copy work you have no right to copy
Reverse engineer or tamper with the app or its ads
Interfere with the app's normal operation or with another person's Pinterest account

section6.title: 6. Disclaimer
section6.content: The app is provided “as is” and “as available”. Tracing depends on your camera, lighting and how you hold the phone. To the extent permitted by applicable law, Zuki Apps disclaims all warranties, express or implied.
section6.content2: Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability that applicable law does not allow to be excluded or limited.

section7.title: 7. Limitation of liability
section7.content: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Zuki Apps is not liable for indirect or consequential damages, or for loss of data, arising from your use of the app.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may modify these Terms. Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.
